This graph shows changes in the average surface temperature of the world’s oceans. Historical observations are from 1880 through 2023. Modeled projections for four different climate scenarios are from 2015 through 2100. Historical model outputs are shown from 1880 to 2023. Modeled outputs are smoothed using an 11-year moving average. The shaded band around the observed line shows the range of uncertainty in the data, based on the number of measurements collected and the precision of the methods used. Other shaded bands show the range of unsmoothed annual values from different climate models. Select items in the legend to toggle them on or off.
